review:
Horse racing at a deliberate pace. Horse values collect on wilds, and golden bonus symbols build towards free spins, where the multipliers climb higher than usual.

There are three bonus versions to buy: Super (multipliers up to 10x), Mega (up to 25x) and Ultra (up to 100x). Medium volatility, 5,000x max and an excellent 97.2% RTP, with free spins about once every 177 spins. If you like collect games but find Big Bass too swingy, this is a calmer ride.
pros: Excellent 97.20% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
